continuity.character_baseline: v0.5.64 front/rear paint and existing geometry
continuity.architecture: Current authored Eclipse Citadel terraces, conical-roof towers, stair approach and keep; actual Ashen Village and Lantern Refuge guides
continuity.palette: Near-black indigo and violet atmosphere; restrained amber lanterns; naturally weathered steel, ivory cloth, olive and brown leather
continuity.curse: Organic violet threads and storm fronts; visible casting cause and physical consequence; no flat neon circle
continuity.knight: Closed gray-steel helmet with aged-brass trim; ivory sun tabard; brown belts; existing elongated steel shield and gold-hilt sword; no invented cape or uncovered face
continuity.maldrek: Same aged pale face, silver-gray hair/goatee, charcoal/plum robes, silver embroidery/chains; existing dark forked staff and violet crystal
continuity.narrative: Deliberately hostile wizard draining vitality through four seals and one artifact; failed expedition; survivors and refuge; no new gameplay gate, immunity power or moral reversal

shots.action: Cloud banks cross the moon; pine tips bend; the same terraced citadel emerges through fog. Faint violet haze gathers at the highest keep.
shots.camera: Slow aerial push toward the central stair axis; natural parallax; no building morphing.
shots.sound: Low wind, one distant bell, restrained low strings; no spoken text baked into video.

narration.en: Four ancient seals once guarded the kingdom. Above them stood the citadel, watched over by the Order.
narration.bg: Някога четири древни печата закриляха кралството. Над тях се издигаше цитаделата, пазена от Ордена.
narration.ru: Некогда четыре древние печати защищали королевство. Над ними возвышалась цитадель под охраной Ордена.
narration.fr: Quatre sceaux antiques protégeaient autrefois le royaume. Au-dessus d'eux se dressait la citadelle, gardée par l'Ordre.
narration.ar: كانت أربعة أختام قديمة تحمي المملكة. وفوقها قامت القلعة التي كان فرسان المملكة يحرسونها.

shots.action: Maldrek closes his outstretched fingers slowly; four violet threads tighten into the brass-caged anchor; candle flames lean away.
shots.camera: Controlled shallow arc toward his face and the anchor, keeping the staff and hand anatomy stable.
shots.sound: Metal resonance, low inward breath of magic, four subtle pulses.

narration.en: Maldrek seized it and bound the seals to an artifact. He drained the kingdom's life to prolong his reign.
narration.bg: Малдрек я превзе и обвърза печатите с артефакт. Започна да източва живота на кралството, за да продължи своето владичество.
narration.ru: Малдрек захватил её и связал печати с артефактом. Он вытягивал из королевства жизнь, чтобы продлить своё правление.
narration.fr: Maldrek s'en empara et lia les sceaux à un artefact. Il puisait dans la vie du royaume pour prolonger son règne.
narration.ar: استولى مالدريك على القلعة، وربط الأختام بقطعة أثرية. وراح يمتص حياة المملكة ليطيل حكمه.

shots.action: Wind lifts dead leaves along the actual half-timbered village street. A lantern gutters; a barred door closes behind distant captive silhouettes.
shots.camera: Low tracking move past the well toward iron bars; practical foreground occlusion and atmospheric depth.
shots.sound: Shutter creak, dry leaves, door slam, distant chain.

narration.en: Crops withered. The dead rose. Those who survived were dragged behind iron doors.
narration.bg: Посевите изсъхнаха. Мъртвите се надигнаха. Оцелелите бяха отвлечени зад железни врати.
narration.ru: Посевы увяли. Мёртвые восстали. Уцелевших уволокли за железные двери.
narration.fr: Les récoltes se flétrirent. Les morts se relevèrent. Les survivants furent emmenés derrière des portes de fer.
narration.ar: ذبلت المحاصيل. ونهض الموتى. وسيق الناجون خلف أبواب من حديد.

shots.action: The exact sun-tabard knight and two distant Order knights walk with weight along the current wet forest road. Cloth, hands, knees and shoulders move naturally.
shots.camera: Side-front tracking at chest height with a gentle push toward the protagonist; no static poses or skating feet.
shots.sound: Armored footsteps, leather and chainmail; distant thunder grows.

narration.en: Your master led the Order down the old forest road. You believed you could still reach the citadel.
narration.bg: Твоят наставник поведе Ордена по стария горски път. Вярваше, че още можете да стигнете цитаделата.
narration.ru: Твой наставник повёл Орден по старой лесной дороге. Ты верил, что до цитадели ещё можно добраться.
narration.fr: Ton maître mena l'Ordre sur l'ancienne route forestière. Tu croyais encore pouvoir atteindre la citadelle.
narration.ar: قاد معلمك الفرسان عبر طريق الغابة القديم. وكنت تظن أن بلوغ القلعة ما زال ممكنا.

shots.action: Maldrek plants his feet, raises the same staff and thrusts his free hand outward. Violet light travels visibly from the anchor/staff into the storm, with real hair and sleeve movement.
shots.camera: Low three-quarter arc, brief push on his deliberate gesture, then widen to reveal the storm responding.
shots.sound: Rising pressure, staff impact and sharp release; no giant flat ring.

narration.en: Maldrek saw you coming. He raised his staff, and the curse tore open the sky.
narration.bg: Малдрек ви видя. Вдигна жезъла си — и проклятието разкъса небето.
narration.ru: Малдрек увидел вас. Он поднял посох, и проклятие разорвало небо.
narration.fr: Maldrek vous vit arriver. Il leva son bâton, et la malédiction déchira le ciel.
narration.ar: رآكم مالدريك قادمين. رفع عصاه، فمزقت اللعنة السماء.

shots.action: Violet wind strikes the forest road. The protagonist braces behind his actual shield, drops to one knee and reaches toward a falling armored companion; both remain anatomically coherent, no gore.
shots.camera: Close shoulder-level track with restrained impact shake, then dip with the reaching hand; motivated occlusion to dark at the end.
shots.sound: Shield crack, branch snap, two weighted falls; abrupt muffled silence.

narration.en: Shields shattered. Your companions fell. You reached for a fallen knight, but the darkness took him.
narration.bg: Щитовете се пръснаха. Другарите ти паднаха. Протегна ръка към един от тях, но мракът го погълна.
narration.ru: Щиты раскололись. Твои товарищи пали. Ты протянул руку упавшему рыцарю, но тьма поглотила его.
narration.fr: Les boucliers se brisèrent. Tes compagnons tombèrent. Tu tendis la main vers l'un d'eux, mais les ténèbres l'emportèrent.
narration.ar: تحطمت الدروع وسقط رفاقك. مددت يدك إلى أحدهم، لكن الظلام ابتلعه.

shots.action: The same knight exhales, grips damp earth with one gauntlet and pushes from the ground onto one knee. The visor stays closed. A distant warm lantern catches on his helmet.
shots.camera: Low close view of the grounded hand, eased rise to the visor and a rack focus toward the lantern.
shots.sound: Breath through visor, soft armor scrape, a faint lantern rattle.

narration.en: You woke among broken banners. Beyond the silent trees, one lantern was still burning.
narration.bg: Събуди се сред пречупени знамена. Отвъд притихналите дървета още гореше един фенер.
narration.ru: Ты очнулся среди сломанных знамён. За безмолвными деревьями всё ещё горел один фонарь.
narration.fr: Tu t'éveillas parmi des bannières brisées. Au-delà des arbres silencieux, une lanterne brûlait encore.
narration.ar: استيقظت بين الرايات المحطمة. وخلف الأشجار الصامتة، كان مصباح واحد لا يزال مشتعلا.

shots.action: The knight stands and takes a first weighted step along the actual refuge approach. Wind moves the ivory tabard, grass and branches; one amber lantern pulls attention down the forest path.
shots.camera: Move from three-quarter visor close view to over-shoulder road view, ending aligned with the current new-journey spawn direction; gentle fade to gameplay loading.
shots.sound: First warmer musical phrase, wind softens, one grounded footstep.

narration.en: A ruined chapel waits beyond the trees. Find the other survivors. You cannot reclaim this kingdom alone.
narration.bg: Отвъд гората те чака разрушен параклис. Намери другите оцелели. Не можеш да си върнеш това кралство сам.
narration.ru: За деревьями ждёт разрушенная часовня. Найди остальных выживших. В одиночку это королевство не вернуть.
narration.fr: Une chapelle en ruine t'attend au-delà des arbres. Retrouve les autres survivants. Tu ne peux reconquérir ce royaume seul.
narration.ar: ينتظرك مصلى متهدم خلف الأشجار. ابحث عن بقية الناجين. لن تستعيد هذه المملكة وحدك.

delivery_requirements: Actual temporally generated video, not animated still-image pans; verify subject and environmental motion
No baked dialogue, narration, title or subtitles; retain existing offline five-language voice and native captions
Preserve current release and 40-second intro until all new clips and timing are accepted
Do not invent footage, report 60 FPS by duplicating frames or promise measured phone performance
Check hands, faces, emblem, equipment, architecture, continuity and camera motion on every shot
Create 1080p runtime encodes only after a native Godot decode/pacing test; larger masters stay outside runtime
Keep Skip, cancellation, safe camp handoff and language changes working; old saves unchanged
No purchase, subscription or public upload without specific owner authorization
revision: v7: continuous skins, grounded distinct falls, visible captive, motivated cuts
